Joseph Bach · Itach · making-of as a commercial

Pick the set the camera flies through.

Four set concepts in the paper world. The grey screen is where the real Plnty recording goes. A real 3D proof in Blender is building now.

01 · Paper tabletop

A laptop on a desk shows the Plnty board; the 8 worlds rise around it as paper dioramas.

02 · City of eight worlds

A street of paper stage flats built from the 8 worlds; the Plnty screen hangs over it like a billboard.

03 · Paper TV studio

A paper stage with lights; the 8 worlds are backdrops that fly in and out around the screen.

04 · Spiral world well

A spiral of paper shelves, each a world; the camera dives down the well past the screen.
